title: The Radiance of the Brightness
description: The Radiance of the Brightness in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Greek Office Books (Paisley, 1904), headed “And all are held in night;”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Common Metre (8.6.8.6), and this page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: The ra-di-ance of the bright-ness Of beau-ty shed by Thee, De-scend on us who hymn Thy name, Sole rul-ing Trin-i-ty.

lines: Descend on us who hymn Thy name,
For Thou hast hallowed it through grace
In faith we laud the Father,
One God, yet Three in One.
To Thee our God be glory,
Both now, and while the ages run

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Greek Office Books (1904)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Greek Office Books; set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
